name: Grain
tagline: Grain is an AI meeting recorder and conversation intelligence tool for sales teams. It automatically clips the most important moments from recorded calls, adds AI-generated summaries, and pushes key data to your CRM with a single click. Deal coaches use Grain's highlight reels to train reps on what good discovery and objection handling look like.
